method: Firefox native UI through computer use; rendered accessibility text and screenshots. No script injection or backend request replay.
scope: Public Bible and two 2-player training sessions against the computer, with apocalypse set to none. Human multiplayer modes were not entered.
privacy: Names are replaced by viewer/CPU roles. No user IDs, account credentials, session URLs, request bodies or full source text are stored.

training_observations.label: cpu-first-sale-awaiting-response
training_observations.model_mapping: Names and displayed facts map to archived cards.json: sell and spiritual-staff; IDs were not read from a game response.
training_observations.limitation: Attempts to activate the empty response did not yield an observable resolved action during this inspection. Invoice, delivery, refill and next-owner results are unknown; no server rejection or cause is established.

training_observations.label: viewer-first-weapon-selection
training_observations.model_mapping: The plate-of-strike name and ATK5/DEF7/price3 map to archived cards.json; not a captured wire model ID.
training_observations.limitation: Selection and preview were observed. An accepted attack, CPU defense, actual damage, consumption, refill and next GF were not observed. Prayer attempts with visible weapons do not establish a valid submitted prayer.

interpretation: These are finite UI observations, not universal server invariants or a runnable full-state replay fixture. They neither prove hidden CPU inventory nor authorize replacing missing transitions with local engine predictions.
